maintenance_backlog: Separate queue receipt from exit parameters.
Test causal persistence of prior intraday returns without opening-range selection.
Resolve OHLC threshold-fill and stale-admission-mark assumptions before treating analytical bounds as native certificates.

rules: Register each hypothesis, catalogue, seeds and code before market outcomes.
Keep generator, capital, cost assumptions, risk caps and original acceptance hurdles unchanged in this program.
Retain every failure and past trial count. Never reuse viewed final paths as new holdout.
Open reserved final only after all registered development eligibility gates pass.
Require operational coverage and independent arithmetic review before declaring N9-S.
A favourable finite Monte Carlo run is conditional evidence, never a guarantee of real profitability.
Run one bounded round per scheduled invocation, at most4 workers; never connect brokers or send orders.
If there is a demonstrated infeasibility under applicable assumptions, report the bound and pause searches of that unchanged contract.
After2 rounds with no measured improvement, require a materially different, documented structural hypothesis before another economic search.
Persist state and evidence with compare-and-swap Git leases; do not overlap an active run.
validation_alpha_rule: .05 / 2**k for new prospective validation attempt k>=1; no claim of retroactive global coverage
